newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 6.93 points to 6,806.16 as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's meeting on interest rates starting Tuesday, while bonds rose after fresh economic reports pointed to steady growth with little inflation.

* The Jakarta Composite Index ended lower by 3.65 points, or 0.53 percent, ending at 687.47 points on Monday after foreign-led profit-taking in some heavyweights as the market's focus remained on some companies in the Lippo Group, brokers said.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,373.00/3.50 in early trading against the opening of 2,373.25/74.00.
* Snack food manufacturer PT Mayora Indah on report that it expected its 1996 net sales to rise to 335 billion rupiah from 305 billion rupiah in 1995.

* Secondary trading company Rimba Niaga Idola on a report that one firm had announed their intention to buy 4.1 million shares of Rimba Niaga through a tender offer at a price of 1,225 rupiah a share.
* Well-diversified group Bakrie & Brothers on news the firm planned to revamp its loan structure.

* Tin miner PT Tambang Timah ahead of its plan to hold a press conference on its 1996 full-year result which scheduled to be announced on Tuesday. Also on reports that it had serious talks with Indonesian shareholders to take part in the Busang gold project.

* PT Multipolar Corp after shareholder approval on Thursday of its plan to take a 50.1 percent controlling interest in retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima. Also on market speculation of a possible stock split.
* Lippo Securities on a report that it planned to split the nominal value of its stock price to 500 rupiah from the current 1,000 rupiah per share.
* PT Barito Pacific on rumours that new investors may enter Indonesia's largest plywood firm.
* PT Lippo Life on news it had revised up its 1996 net profit target to 130.8 billion rupiah from 100.3 billion rupiah.
